description.value: Nellie's European Deli has been a community institution in Nanaimo since 1998, operating out of Rock City Centre and specialising in imported European groceries from Holland, Germany, Sweden, Poland, and beyond. The deli counter turns out house-made sandwiches, daily soups, and freshly baked meat pies in varieties ranging from steak-and-kidney to turkey cranberry, with gluten-free options available. For a touring cyclist, it offers a convenient stop for a hot or packaged meal along the Island Highway corridor.

address.value: 2980 Island Highway North #500, Nanaimo, BC V9T 5V4
